subject: The trial went well. There was still plenty to sort out.
preheader: A flexible approach to payment and delivery is helping turn a successful trial into a practical solution.
intro: We've been helping an OT arrange a mattress trial for a participant who was hiring a bed.
The trial went well, and the mattress looked to be the right choice. We then worked through the replacement bed and accessories to bring the whole setup together.
sectionTitle: Making it work for the person.
body: The OT had completed the report. We brought the replacement bed, the mattress already in use and the accessories together in a revised quote.
The purchase has now been processed and invoiced, and we're already coordinating delivery. Our flexibility around payment timing means we can keep things moving without waiting for payment to arrive.

That helps make the changeover more straightforward, with the participant's needs driving the approach. The equipment, payment timing and delivery are being worked through together, with a view to bringing the ongoing bed hire to an end sooner.
actionText: If you're working through something similar, just reply and tell us what you're trying to organise. We can help work through the equipment options and the practical next steps.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: In-home trial options and availability depend on the equipment and service area.
